title: Coefficient automorphism comparing transported derived traces
statement: Let C be a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category and f:X → Y, g:Y → Z, h:X → Z morphisms with f g=h. Suppose Rf_* is an equivalence. Given F ≅ Rh_*, a coefficient isomorphism b:L ≅ Rf_* B, an isomorphism v:V ≅ B and z:Rf_* V ≅ L, and an arbitrary trace Rg_* L → U followed by a map U → W, there is an automorphism a of B. Mapping a by F and then using the composite formed from v inverse, the canonical composition comparison and z is equal to the composite formed from b inverse and the canonical equality/composition comparisons. This asserts an equality of transported trace composites only; it gives no adjunction or triangle. The definitions and interfaces used here are [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: Both diagonal triangle calculations and the actual inverse-projection counit.

proof.text: Under full faithfulness of Rf_*, lift b inverse followed by the inverse of the alternate coefficient identification to an automorphism a of B. Naturality of the comparison F ≅ Rh_* and of the derived composition isomorphism moves its image to the coefficient slot, where the alternate identification cancels. This gives the required equation for a single composition isomorphism.

Naturality moves the coefficient comparison v inverse across derived composition. Identify the composition isomorphism for f g=h with ordinary composition followed by the equality isomorphism: eliminate the equality and both components are definitionally the same. Substitute its inverse component in the generic trace calculation and reassociate.

theorem exists_derivedTraceAdjustment
    (C : Type v) [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z) (w : f ≫ g = h)
    [(lowerStar C f).rightDerivedFunctor.IsEquivalence]
    (F : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology C) ⥤
      _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology C))
    (r : F ≅ (lowerStar C h).rightDerivedFunctor)
    {B V : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology C)}
    {L : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology C)}
    (b : L ≅ (lowerStar C f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj B)
    (v : V ≅ B) (z : (lowerStar C f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj V ≅ L)
    {U W : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology C)}
    (trace : (lowerStar C g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj L ⟶ U) (j : U ⟶ W) :
    ∃ a : B ≅ B,
      F.map a.hom ≫ (r.hom.app B ≫ (lowerStar C h).rightDerivedFunctor.map v.inv ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerStarCompOfEq C f g h w).inv.app V ≫
        (lowerStar C g).rightDerivedFunctor.map z.hom ≫ trace ≫ j) =
      r.hom.app B ≫ ((rightDerivedLowerStarCongr C w).inv.app B ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerStarComp C f g).inv.app B ≫
        (lowerStar C g).rightDerivedFunctor.map b.inv ≫ trace) ≫ j
